phoenix_prompt_version_context.description: This guidance applies when the user is viewing a saved prompt version in the UI, i.e., when `ui_contexts` has a `promptVersion` entry.
phoenix_prompt_version_context.guidance: - Use `promptVersionNodeId`, scoped by `promptNodeId`, when the user asks about this revision's messages, model configuration, invocation parameters, tools, tags, or how it differs from other prompt versions.
